subject: Post-call recap: Assurance package milestones and artifact commitments
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bankco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Assurance package milestones and artifact commitments

Hi Liam — thanks again for the call earlier today. Per our discussion I’m sending a short post-call recap and a draft of the assurance milestones we discussed (attached). The goal is to get alignment on owners, deliverables, and a firm target for the security review so we can keep the deal moving.

High-level summary / agreed next steps:
- We will provide our SOC 2 artifact checklist and a staged evidence bundle for your security review. (Attachment: SOC2_artifact_checklist_v1.pdf)
- Proposed target for security review completion: Oct 20, 2026. Please let us know if that timing works for your team.
- Dependencies called out: signed NDA, S3 upload access (or a secure SharePoint/Drive destination), and procurement PO for pilot capacity.

Draft milestones (owners & tentative due dates):
1) NDA signed — Owner: Contracts (BankCo) / RW intake — Target: 2026-09-21
2) Security questionnaire & baseline answers submitted — Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) — Target: 2026-09-24
3) Evidence bundle (staging) uploaded to shared Drive — Owner: Marissa Cole (Redwood) — Target: 2026-10-01
4) BankCo security review & feedback — Owner: BankCo SecOps — Target: 2026-10-13
5) Final artifact delivery (zip of requested docs) — Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) — Target: 2026-10-20

Attachments: redwood_assurance_milestones_v1.xlsx (MAP draft with milestone columns and owners), SOC2_artifact_checklist_v1.pdf (requested artifact types and minimal examples).

Open questions for you:
1) Who is the canonical SecOps contact for artifact ingestion and review? (email + preferred transfer method)
2) Are there any additional artifact types beyond the checklist we should include (e.g., SIEM exports, raw audit logs, HSM attestations)?
3) Does the target window above (security review complete by Oct 20) align with your procurement timelines?

If that looks right I’ll mark these milestones in the MAP and we’ll send the questionnaire answers this Friday (09/24).

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@bankco.com>

Cc: security-ops@bankco.com, contracts@bankco.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:07:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Assurance package milestones and artifact commitments

Neha — thanks for the clear recap and the attachments. A few quick clarifications from SecOps:  

- Canonical contact: please loop in security-ops@bankco.com (distribution inbox monitored by our SecOps triage team) and I’ll introduce you to Claire Morgan (Lead InfoSec) for final sign-off.
- Regarding artifacts: we will need explicit audit-log retention statements (how long logs are kept, storage class, and deletion policies) and a sample of your access-control policy showing RBAC groups for model runtime.
- On timing: Oct 20 is ambitious for full sign-off. We can commit to an initial security review and feedback by Oct 13, but final sign-off will depend on procurement completing the PO and our legal review. If you can stage the artifacts by Oct 1, we should be able to surface feedback by Oct 13.

Also — we require a signed mutual NDA before we accept downloadable artifacts to our systems. Can your contracts team circulate the NDA? contracts@bankco.com is copied.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director, Infrastructure Security
BankCo Financial
